grants.justification: Consent-gated public publication surface. RLS is enabled and policy collective_publication_read restricts anon reads to rows with status='published' AND consent_state='explicit'. Only the owner (via authenticated insert/update/delete policies) can publish. No write path for anon.

Public short-link resolution for the redirect worker, which calls with the anon key. SECURITY DEFINER: returns only the single matching active link's id and target_url; there is deliberately no SELECT grant or anon select policy on public.smart_links, so anon can never enumerate the link directory. The worker records the click from the returned link_id (append-only RLS insert on public.smart_link_clicks). Reserved, unknown, or inactive names return no row, which the worker serves as 404.
